schema_note: v1.7 baseline measurement protocols responding to the inclusiveness review gap. Protocol design only — no field data exists; every indicator stays 'pending_baseline' until measured. Machine-readable companion of proposal.md section '现场基线测量方案'. P3 extended with tiered first-response SLA in v2.8; binding thresholds live in commitment-thresholds.json.

protocols.object_zh: 六站厅与主线廊道出入口、坡道、电梯、无障碍卫生间
protocols.object_en: Hall/corridor entrances, ramps, lifts, accessible toilets

protocols.name_zh: 非数字化等价路径可达率
protocols.object_zh: 每个 AI 服务点的人工问询、纸质导览等等价路径
protocols.object_en: Staffed desk / print guides at each AI service point

protocols.object_zh: 站厅现场与线上渠道工单
protocols.definition: median hours from receipt to first reply

protocols.name_zh: 第三方无障碍专业审查
protocols.definition: professional audit report with remediation list

discipline.self_check_limit: machine-vision self-checks do not substitute for professional accessibility certification
discipline.no_data_policy: unmeasured indicators remain pending_baseline; design-model values must not be reported as measured

boundary_zh: 概念协议；测量主体、预算与抽样框以试点正式立项为准，不构成任何实测结论。
boundary_en: Conceptual protocols; measurement owner, budget and sampling frames pending formal pilot approval; no measured conclusions.
